statement.en: whatever arises is embodied: at every step it is active exactly where its level is not within nothing (World.InAmounts.ArisingEmbodied M v)
across every step every level after the step, with what is taken from it, is within its level before, with what is given to it (World.InAmounts.Balanced M v)

name.en: the family balances in the amounts

statement.en: across each step the law names (the step from t, or every step from T on), each member's level after the step, with what is taken from it, is within its level before, with what is given to it: no amount is made (World.InAmounts.BalancesOn M v ds t)

name.en: the family dissipated on in the amounts
